description: Headless cron job scheduler for norc — can install (opt-in: `norc service install`) a per-user Scheduled Task (`norc bridge`) that syncs this machine's crontab with the norc web vault.
post_install: if ($env:NORC_INSTALL_SERVICE -eq '1') { & "$dir\norc.exe" service install; & "$dir\norc.exe" __dupe-check } else { Write-Host "norc: background service NOT installed. Run 'norc service install' to enable it (opt-in), or set NORC_INSTALL_SERVICE=1 and reinstall." }
